newsitem.title: USA: New York Times to sell six magazines.
newsitem.headline: New York Times to sell six magazines.

text.p: The New York Times Co said on Wednesday that it plans to sell six magazines and related businesses that had total 1996 revenues of about $44 million.
The magazines include Tennis and Tennis Buyer's Guide, Cruising World and Sailing World, Snow Country and Snow Country Business.
The company said in a release that the publications had "not achieved financial returns that are consistent with our corporate goals."
Company spokeswoman Nancy Nielsen declined to comment on potential buyers and said there is no set time frame for the sale.

The company said it plans to focus on its golf-related publications and businesses, which include Golf Digest and Golf World. It said both publications are market leaders and that it is expanding operations related to those magazines.
